answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 18687 Country: India Title: my husband said three times mai tumhe talaaq deta hun to me.is the divorce was happen or not? pls tell me. Question: my husband said three times mai tumhe talaaq deta hun to me.is the divorce was happen or not? pls tell me. Answer ID: 18687 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 104/105=B=1431) If the husband admits the same, the three talaqs will be considered to be valid and effective. This will break their relation of nikah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
